record.paper_title: Some Open Problems and Conjectures Associated with the Invariant Subspace Problem
record.original_question: Let T be a bounded operator on a real or complex Banach space with no non-trivial closed invariant subspaces. Let Alg T denote the algebra of all polynomials in T, let the bar denote closure in the weak operator topology, and let {T}' denote the commutant of T, the algebra of all bounded operators that commute with T. Is the weak-operator-topology closure of Alg T equal to {T}'?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a real or complex Banach space, and let $T:X\to X$ be a bounded linear operator. Assume that $T$ has no non-trivial closed invariant subspace, i.e., the only closed subspaces $M\subseteq X$ with $T(M)\subseteq M$ are $\{0\}$ and $X$.

Define:
- $\mathrm{Alg}\,T := \{ p(T) : p \text{ is a polynomial with scalar coefficients} \}$, the unital algebra of all polynomials in $T$.
- $\overline{\mathrm{Alg}\,T}^{\mathrm{WOT}}$, the closure of $\mathrm{Alg}\,T$ in the weak operator topology on $B(X)$ (the algebra of bounded linear operators on $X$).
- $\{T\}' := \{ S \in B(X) : ST = TS \}$, the commutant of $T$.

Determine whether the equality
$$\overline{\mathrm{Alg}\,T}^{\mathrm{WOT}} \;=\; \{T\}'$$
holds for every such operator $T$.
artifact.category_tag: Invariant subspace problem / Banach space operators
artifact.status_search_result: The invariant subspace problem itself remains open on separable Hilbert spaces, and this conjecture is a refinement concerning operators that are counterexamples (which exist on certain non-reflexive Banach spaces). No published resolution of this specific conjecture about the WOT-closure of polynomials in T equaling the commutant of T was located; it appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Invariant subspace problem - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: The problem is still open for separable Hilbert spaces; each example of an operator with no non-trivial invariant subspaces found so far acts on a Banach space not isomorphic to a separable Hilbert space.
status_evidence.claim: The broader invariant subspace problem remains open, and the associated conjectures about operators without invariant subspaces are still active.

status_evidence.title: Invariant subspaces for commuting operators in a real Banach space
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of commutants and invariant subspaces in Banach spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Related conjectures on commutants of operators without invariant subspaces continue to be investigated.
